label: A space directly followed by a character the tokenizer splits into raw byte pieces: uncommon emoji and symbols (chess pieces, snowman, APL), rare Chinese characters, many Korean syllables and katakana; also the long mark ー before a split katakana, and accented letters inside pointed Hebrew or polytonic Greek. Quiet when the same symbol is glued to a Latin word or punctuation, at text start, and for common characters kept as whole tokens (€, →, everyday Chinese, Cyrillic, Arabic, accented Latin).
